title: WILO workout
description: A workout in users/{uid}/assigned or users/{uid}/completed: what a workout, exercise and set need to mean something to a human. Extra fields are allowed.

id.description: Shared by an assigned workout and its completed copy.

assignedFor.description: The date this workout is for. Lets the coach lay out several workouts on specific dates.

name.description: Whatever the user calls it. No catalog, no linking.

custom_name.description: Header for one free-text column per set (e.g. Risers, Side).

lbs.description: Weight, or "" when not set yet. Blank doesn't necessarily mean bodyweight.

reps.description: Number (seconds when timed), or "" when not set yet.
